name: Sanction of Motorized Three Wheeler to Orthopedically Challenged
teName: ఆర్థోపెడిక్ ఛాలెంజ్డ్ కు మోటారు చేయబడిన త్రీ వీలర్ మంజూరు
teBrief: "ఆర్థోపెడికల్లీ ఛాలెంజ్డ్ కు మోటరైజ్డ్ త్రీ వీలర్ మంజూరు" పథకం కీళ్ళ వికలాంగులకు మోటరైజ్డ్ త్రీ వీలర్లను అందించడం లక్ష్యంగా పెట్టుకుంది.
brief: The "Sanction of Motorized Three Wheeler to Orthopedically Challenged" scheme aims to provide motorized three wheelers to orthopedically challenged persons. This initiative ensures that eligible individuals receive support to enhance their mobility and independence.
briefFull: The "Sanction of Motorized Three Wheeler to Orthopedically Challenged" scheme aims to provide motorized three wheelers to orthopedically challenged persons. This initiative ensures that eligible individuals receive support to enhance their mobility and independence.
details: The A.P. Differently Abled & Senior Citizens Assistance Corporation, Andhra Pradesh launched scheme "Sanction of Motorized Three Wheeler to Orthopedically Challenged" under its Action Plan 2017-18, aims to provide Motorized Three Wheelers to orthopedically challenged persons. The Motorized Three Wheelers are distributed by the Assistant Directors, Department for the Welfare of Differently Abled & Senior Citizens, and District Managers, A.P. Differently Abled & Senior Citizens Assistance Corporation.
benefits: - Eligible persons with disabilities are provided with a motorized three-wheeler (customized/adapted for their use) to enhance their independence, mobility, and access to education or livelihood opportunities.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be between 18 to 45 years of age.
1. The applicant should have a disability of 70% or above.
1. The applicant's family annual income should not exceed ₹3,00,000/-.
1. The applicant should be a bonafede student pursuing graduation or higher courses regularly.
1. The applicant should be self-employed (including in agriculture and allied activities) or wage/salary employed for a minimum period of one year, and must have passed at least the 10th class.
1. The applicant should obtain a valid driving licence for driving an adapted vehicle (previously called an invalid carriage) as per the Motor Vehicle Act within two months from the date of selection.
1. The applicant is eligible for sanction only once in a lifetime.
howToApply:
[Online]
**Step 01:** Visit the official website: [https://apdascac.ap.gov.in](https://apdascac.ap.gov.in)
**Step 02:** On the homepage, click on "[APDASCAC Schemes](https://apdascac.ap.gov.in/APDASCAC-Schemes/)".
**Step 03:** Select the "SANCTION OF ADULT STICKS" option.
**Step 04:** Click on "Apply Now" to begin the application process.
**Step 05:** Fill in the required details and submit your application.
> **Note:** Online applications will be allowed when the scheme is permitted by an advertisement in newspaper.
documentsRequired:
- Disability Certificate
- Aadhaar Card
- SSC Certificate
- Caste Certificate in case of SC/ST/BC
- Passport size photo
- Latest Income Certificate
- Bonafide Certificate from the institution for the student category
- Self/Wage employment Certificate from the concerned MPDO/Municipal Commissioner for Self/Wage Category
- Self Declaration on punishment for fraudulently availing any benefit meant for Persons with Disabilities.
- Self Declaration that he/she has not availed the benefit of a Motorized Vehicle earlier from the Government, Government Agency/ Private Agency, or any other source, and he/she should not have any Motorized Vehicle two/three/or four-wheeler of his/her own

faqs.q: Who is eligible to receive a Motorized Three Wheeler under this scheme?
faqs.a:
To be eligible for this scheme, the applicant should:
Age between 18-45 years.
70% & above Disability.
Annual Income of family should not be more than Rs.3.00 lakhs.
Bonafide students studying Graduation and above courses regularly.
Self employed including Agriculture & Allied activities or wage/salary employed for minimum one year period with 10th Class Pass
Should acquire valid driving licence for driving an adopted vehicle (earlier it was invalid carriage) issued under Motor Vehicle Act within two months from the date of selection
Sanctioned once in a life time.
faqs.qTe: ఈ పథకం కింద మోటరైజ్డ్ త్రీ వీలర్ పొందడానికి ఎవరు అర్హులు?

faqs.q: Can the Motorized Three Wheeler be transferred to another person?
faqs.a: No, the Motorized Three Wheeler is issued to the individual and is non-transferable.
faqs.qTe: మోటారు చేయబడిన త్రీ వీలర్ ను మరొక వ్యక్తికి బదిలీ చేయవచ్చా?

faqs.q: How often can an individual receive a Motorized Three Wheeler under this scheme?
faqs.a: An individual can receive a Motorized Three Wheeler once in their lifetime.
faqs.qTe: ఈ పథకం కింద ఒక వ్యక్తి మోటరైజ్డ్ త్రీ వీలర్ను ఎంత తరచుగా పొందవచ్చు?

faqs.q: Who is responsible for distributing the Motorized Three Wheelers?
faqs.a: The Motorized Three Wheelers are distributed by the Assistant Directors and District Managers of the respective departments.
faqs.qTe: మోటరైజ్డ్ త్రీ వీలర్ల పంపిణీకి ఎవరు బాధ్యత వహిస్తారు?

faqs.q: What documents are required to apply for a Motorized Three Wheeler?
faqs.a:
1. Disability Certificate
1. Aadhaar Card
1. SSC Certificate
1. Caste Certificate in case of SC/ST/BC
1. Passport size photo
1. Latest Income Certificate
1. Bonafide Certificate from the institution for student category
1. Self/Wage employment Certificate from concerned MPDO/ Muncipal Commissioner for Self/Wage Category
1. Self Declaration on punishment for fraudulently availing any benefit meant for Persons with Disabilities.
1. Self Declaration that he/she has not availed the benefit of Motorized Vehicle earlier from the Government, Government Agency/ Private Agency or any other source and he/she should not have any Motorized Vehicle two/three/four wheeler of his/her own.
faqs.qTe: మోటరైజ్డ్ త్రీ వీలర్ కోసం దరఖాస్తు చేయడానికి ఏ పత్రాలు అవసరం?

faqs.q: Is there a deadline for submitting applications?
faqs.a: Yes, a minimum of one month from the date of notification will be provided for submitting applications.

faqs.q: What happens if there are more eligible candidates than available units?
faqs.a: Preference will be given to students whose remaining period for course completion is longer and those from remote areas.
faqs.qTe: అందుబాటులో ఉన్న యూనిట్ల కంటే ఎక్కువ అర్హత గల అభ్యర్థులు ఉంటే ఏమి జరుగుతుంది?

faqs.q: What measures are in place to prevent double or false claims?
faqs.a: Records of beneficiaries are maintained to avoid double or false claims, and verification is conducted before approval.
faqs.qTe: డబుల్ లేదా తప్పుడు క్లెయిమ్లను నివారించడానికి ఏ చర్యలు ఉన్నాయి?

faqs.q: Can individuals with mental retardation or illness apply for this scheme?
faqs.a: No, individuals with mental retardation or illness are not eligible.
faqs.qTe: మెంటల్ రిటార్డేషన్ లేదా అనారోగ్యం ఉన్న వ్యక్తులు ఈ పథకానికి దరఖాస్తు చేయవచ్చా?

faqs.q: What should a beneficiary do if they no longer need the Motorized Three Wheeler?
faqs.a: They should return the Motorized Three Wheeler to the distribution office or follow the specified guidelines provided by the Corporation.
faqs.qTe: ఇకపై మోటరైజ్డ్ త్రీ వీలర్ అవసరం లేకపోతే లబ్ధిదారుడు ఏమి చేయాలి?
